$comment: The smallest deployment the gates check, so exclusion is exercised rather than assumed: a client who bought the Workboard, with the client portal. ADR 0032 is measured by it.

Measured on 2026-10-30 with closureOf (scripts/check-deployment.mjs) and generateMounts (scripts/gen-app-mounts.mjs), after ADR 0032's edges changed kind: 10 entities and 180 mounts. Before, 11 entities, internal htt among them, and 188 mounts.

The Workboard alone now closes over 3 entities (boards, client-programs, contacts); before, 9. boards stopped requiring crm (crm files meeting actions through boards), and htt left with the portal's Human Tokens band, now htt's humanTokens slot (null here).

The other six entities here (billing, company-os, crm, finance, ideas, org) come from portal, the second root: its agreements and published meeting notes are crm's, its invoices finance's, its hours raise invoices through company-os, and its team panel reads org. crm brings billing; org brings ideas.
Everything absent is proof the catalogue can leave something out.
name: minimal
